description: Each run in its own tmux window, named after the session, in the runner's tmux session (or in a detached "agent-tasks" session when the runner is not inside tmux). Starts an interactive shell and types the agent command into it, so shell aliases work; the shell exits with the agent. tmux knows nothing about agents: status only tells whether the window is still there (working) or gone or dead (exited), so blocked runs are not detected.
launch: name=$1 cwd=$2; shift 2; if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then exec tmux new-window -d -P -F '#{window_id}' -t "$(tmux display -p '#S'):" -n "$name" -c "$cwd" -- "$@"; elif tmux has-session -t '=agent-tasks' 2>/dev/null; then exec tmux new-window -d -P -F '#{window_id}' -t '=agent-tasks:' -n "$name" -c "$cwd" -- "$@"; else exec tmux new-session -d -P -F '#{window_id}' -s agent-tasks -n "$name" -c "$cwd" -- "$@"; fi
attach: tmux select-window -t "$1" || exit; if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then exec tmux switch-client -t "$1"; else exec tmux attach-session -t "$1"; fi
